documentation.content: A promise Ferni made failed for a reason that is ours to fix, not the person's: provider-error, store-error, job-not-run, flag-off, not-configured, send-failed. Source: `PROMISE_OUTCOME` lines from src/services/follow-through/promise-outcomes.ts (deferred calls, scheduled outreach, reminders, follow-through texts, on-behalf call results), on the API (Cloud Run JSON logs) and the voice agent (text logs). Open the log entry: `kind` says which executor, `reason` why, and the ids (userId, id, callId, reminderId, followUpId) find the record. Promise-ledger design, alert policy 1.

conditions.displayName: A PROMISE_OUTCOME line is failed with an our-fault reason

conditionMatchedLog.filter: (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND jsonPayload.event="PROMISE_OUTCOME" AND jsonPayload.outcome="failed" AND jsonPayload.reason=("provider-error" OR "store-error" OR "job-not-run" OR "flag-off" OR "not-configured" OR "send-failed")) OR (logName="projects/johnb-2025/logs/cloud-agents" AND textPayload:"\"event\":\"PROMISE_OUTCOME\"" AND textPayload:"\"outcome\":\"failed\"" AND (textPayload:"\"reason\":\"provider-error\"" OR textPayload:"\"reason\":\"store-error\"" OR textPayload:"\"reason\":\"job-not-run\"" OR textPayload:"\"reason\":\"flag-off\"" OR textPayload:"\"reason\":\"not-configured\"" OR textPayload:"\"reason\":\"send-failed\""))
